parameters.query: SELECT c.id as contact_id, c.email, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM la.created_at) as hour_opened, EXTRACT(DOW FROM la.created_at) as day_opened, COUNT(*) as open_count FROM contacts c JOIN lead_activities la ON la.contact_id = c.id WHERE la.activity_type = 'email_opened' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY c.id, c.email, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM la.created_at), EXTRACT(DOW FROM la.created_at) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY c.id
